summary: Ngandajika territory (Lomami province), a densely populated agricultural area between Mwene-Ditu and Mbuji-Mayi, has no known armed-group territorial control. Kamuina Nsapu-linked unrest touched Lomami in 2017 but was suppressed by 2018 without leaving lasting militia rule here. Ngandajika town (territorial seat, agro-industrial park) is policed by the PNC with ANR and some FARDC presence; the Mulumba and Ngandajika rural secteurs and the Kalambayi Kabanga area rely on PNC posts and customary chiefs, with insecurity limited to banditry, land and chieftaincy disputes. Live web research was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted and fetch targets blocked), so the assessment relies on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule, with limited confidence.

zones.description: Ngandajika town and its neighbourhoods (territorial seat)
zones.evidence: Seat of Ngandajika territory with territorial administration and a PNC territorial commissariat; no reports of armed-group control after Kamuina Nsapu-era unrest faded in 2017-2018. Insecurity consists of crime and occasional social unrest. Not verified with fresh sources in this run.

zones.description: Rural Ngandajika and Mulumba secteurs (incl. Ilunga, Ciabila, Mpasu Mutombo, Nyembue)
zones.evidence: Villages with no reported armed-group activity; order maintained by PNC posts and customary chiefs, residual insecurity is banditry and land/chieftaincy disputes. Not verified with fresh sources in this run.

zones.description: Kalambayi Kabanga area (secteur/health zone, incl. Tuvuangana)
zones.evidence: Rural Luba area toward the Lubilanji/Kasai-Oriental border with no known armed-group presence; thin PNC presence backed by customary authorities. Not verified with fresh sources in this run.
